qualification: See README and paired JSON fixtures. Unrestricted oneDNN performance failed the original 32K NLL gate but passed 29/30 paired practical 32K tasks versus 28/30 for reference, and 12/12 paired 128K tasks versus 12/12. At 199K, unrestricted performance reduced six-task wall time from 721.55 to 427.10 seconds but regressed one code-review task (5/6 versus 6/6); a repeat failed the same task. Capping oneDNN at KV length 196608 restored 6/6 on a fresh-start 199K replay and reduced wall time to 458.18 seconds, with two cold code-prefill times 208.17 and 203.78 seconds versus about 336 seconds each for reference. Warm-prefix prefill was approximately reference speed because the last chunks fell back to Q128. The capped candidate has not passed broad quality or serving gates; all oneDNN profiles remain experimental and opt-in. A 128K cancellation/recovery smoke test passed. One staggered 4K-decode plus 32K-prefill pair showed no material difference between profiles. The launcher isolates experimental AOT compile caches by image ID and flags after discovering a cross-W4A8/W4A16 cache confounder. An exact archived W4A16 control image reproduced isolated W4A16 NLL on one 32K prompt. Broader source-review and coding quality, W4A8 factor isolation, memory/concurrency, and mixed-serving gates remain open.
